text:
Maya (infra): Heads-up — Q3 capacity planning thread. I ran a quick hedge matrix for the hosted API surge window (black friday + product launch). Thinking a mixed approach: smaller A800 buy + short-term rentals for the burst. Want to surface APAC egress constraints and cluster health risk if we push warm pool sizes.
Samir: +1 on hybrid. Quick numbers: baseline demand ~180k GPU-hours/month, projected surge peak ~320k GPU-hours/month in Nov. So we need ~140k additional GPU-hours at peak.
Kevin: APAC note — availability for A800s in our preferred datacenter is patchy. Lead times 6–9 weeks for purchases vs 3–7 days for rentals. If we buy, we should commit now for Oct delivery. Rentals give us flexibility for Nov spike.
Anya: Networking/egress hit if we shift more traffic to APAC warm pools. Estimated extra egress cost ~$35k/week at peak if we enable cross-region spillover. Also warm pool churn increases control-plane load; last time we saw scheduler CPU spike 2x during rapid scale up.
Samir: quick calc I shared in the deck earlier:
```
options = [
  {name: "buy_200", gpus:200, monthly_hours:200*24*30},
  {name: "rent_300", gpus:300, monthly_hours:300*24*30}
]
# rough: 200g * 24 * 30 = 144k GPU-hours/mo
```
Buy 200 nets ~144k GPU-hours/mo. Combined buy+rent can cover peak but cost mix matters.
fm-cost-bot: FYI estimated unit costs — buy: $0.14/GPU-hour (amortized) ; rent: $0.32/GPU-hour. Cross-region egress: $0.09/GB. Projected delta on monthly bill (if we rent 300 for 2 months) ~+$290k.
Maya (infra): Ops constraints: we have 6 rack slots free in us-west, 3 in eu-central, 0 in apac-sin. If we buy, we need to schedule delivery + racking window; ops crew availability weeks 41–43 only. Rentals can be provisioned on our cloud partner with same-day onboarding.
Kevin: Also watch cluster health — last warm-pool cold-starts caused KV cache misses and 8–12% token latency regression. We should reserve a small fraction of dedicated capacity pinned to production-critical routes to avoid those misses.
Anya: Proposal: buy +70% of sustained need (so buy ~100–120 GPUs), rent the rest for burst. That minimizes amortized cost and reduces lead-time exposure. Set an APAC egress cap policy so we don't auto-spill beyond budget.
Samir: Simulation results (very rough):
- Buy 120 + Rent 220 for Nov spike -> covers peak, cost ~ +$180k two-month incremental vs rent-only $+290k.
- Buy 200 + Rent 100 -> lower rent but higher capex; payback ~9 months if utilization stays high.
Maya (infra): Action items:
- Samir: finalize procurement RFQ for 120–200 A800 options by EOD Friday.
- Kevin: confirm racking windows and crew for weeks 41–43 by Tue.
- Anya: draft egress cap policy + warm-pool scaling limits; include control-plane CPU guardrails.
- fm-cost-bot: produce 2-month cost delta table for buy-120 vs buy-200 vs rent-only.
ops-bot: Scheduled infra maintenance window reminder — network firmware upgrade planned for 1729890000 (UTC) which may affect warm-pool scaling briefly. Marked P1=false. :warning:
Samir: noted. I'll model the maintenance window in the surge sim (expect ~3–5% reduced effective capacity during the 2h patch).
Kevin: If procurement hits snags, fallback plan: increase rental forecast to 350 for 6 weeks and pre-seed caches in eu/us to reduce cross-region traffic.
Maya (infra): Good discussion. Let's keep this thread for procurement comms. If anyone has vendor quotes, drop PDFs or short notes here. :thumbsup:
Anya: uploaded vendor quote summary to the procurement doc (link) and flagged a note about egress caps.
fm-cost-bot: uploaded cost table for buy-120 vs buy-200 vs rent-only (spreadsheet link).
